label: PF Backlog 295
title: Media context pipeline: asset->prompt selection, per-asset summary fallback, media token accounting, native parts when model-capable (BI-PF-0280)
body: Gap (confirmed by code + industry research): multimodal.py + asset_store.to_media exist but are orphaned; agent_runner never passes media=; nothing reads assets.json to build agent input; no media token/size accounting; no summary fallback. Norm (LangChain Deep Agents / A2A multimodal / Orchestra-o1): producing agents persist to the asset store and emit a text summary + asset ref; consuming agents get NATIVE parts only when their model accepts the modality, else the bounded SUMMARY. Build core/media_context.py (selector) + thread media= through agent_runner._call_llm; charge media tokens into prompt_tokens_est. Reuses multimodal/asset_store/model_catalog/llm_client; no new store.
_note: closed via issue IS-PF-0013: core/media_context.py; core/orchestrator/agent_runner.py; core/orchestrator/llm_client.py; config/env-flags.json; test-framework/tests/pipeline/test_media_context.py
